title: Advantech SUSIAccess Server UpgradeMgmt upload Directory Traversal Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Advantech SUSIAccess Server. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of the UpgradeMgmt servlet upload function. The issue lies in the failure to properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code under the context of SYSTEM.
